name: Husqvarna AB (publ)
summary: Husqvarna AB (publ) produces and sells outdoor power products, watering products, and lawn care power equipment. It operates through three segments: Husqvarna Forest & Garden; Gardena; and Husqvarna Construction. The Husqvarna Forest & Garden segment offers handheld products, such as chainsaws, brush cutters, trimmers, pole saws, tillers and cultivators, scarifiers and dethatchers, pressure and power washers, and leaf blowers; wheeled products, such as front riders and zero-turn mowers; robotic lawn mowers; and accessories and spare parts.
